mapper.select: select distinct activity.id, '主舞台・' || activity."name" as note, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE("session"."date", 'YYYY/MM/DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "value", TO_CHAR(TO_DATE("session"."date", 'YYYY/MM/DD'), 'FMMM"月"FMDD"日"') || ' (' || CASE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM TO_DATE("session"."date", 'YYYY/MM/DD')) WHEN 1 THEN '一' WHEN 2 THEN '二' WHEN 3 THEN '三' WHEN 4 THEN '四' WHEN 5 THEN '五' WHEN 6 THEN '六' WHEN 7 THEN '日' end || ') ' AS "label" FROM "interviewworks_ticket"."activity" activity INNER JOIN "interviewworks_ticket"."session" "session" ON activity.id = "session".activity_id where activity.id = #{activity_id} ORDER BY activity.id

select "session".id, "session"."time" as "value", "session"."time" || ' ' || CASE WHEN "session"."time"::time BETWEEN '06:00'::time AND '11:59:59'::time THEN '早晨場' WHEN "session"."time"::time BETWEEN '12:00'::time AND '17:59:59'::time THEN '午後場' ELSE '星空場' END AS "label", "session".capacity as available FROM "interviewworks_ticket"."session" "session" where "session"."date" = #{date} and "session".activity_id = #{activity_id} ORDER BY "session"."date"

select ticket.orderno, ticket.session_id, "session".activity_id, ticket."name", ticket."date", ticket."time", CASE WHEN ticket."time"::time BETWEEN '06:00'::time AND '11:59:59'::time THEN '早晨場' WHEN ticket."time"::time BETWEEN '12:00'::time AND '17:59:59'::time THEN '午後場' ELSE '星空場' END AS timename, ticket.status FROM "interviewworks_ticket".ticket ticket INNER JOIN "interviewworks_ticket"."session" "session" ON ticket.session_id = "session".id WHERE ticket.customer = #{customer} ORDER BY ticket.orderno desc
select activity.id, activity.price FROM "interviewworks_ticket"."activity" activity where activity.id = #{activity_id}
mapper.update: update "interviewworks_ticket"."session" "session" set capacity = capacity - 1, reserved = reserved + 1 where "session".id = #{session_id} and "session".capacity - "session".reserved - "session".sold >= 1
mapper.select: WITH next_order AS ( INSERT INTO "interviewworks_ticket".ticket_order_sequence ( order_date, current_no ) VALUES ( CURRENT_DATE, 1 ) ON CONFLICT (order_date) DO UPDATE SET current_no = "interviewworks_ticket".ticket_order_sequence.current_no + 1 RETURNING 'CT' || TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYYMMDD') || LPAD(current_no::TEXT, 3, '0') AS orderno ) INSERT INTO "interviewworks_ticket".ticket ( orderno, session_id, customer, email, "name", "date", "time", status, quantity, price, expires_at, paid_at, cancelled_at ) SELECT next_order.orderno, #{session_id}, #{customer}, #{email}, #{name}, #{date}, #{time}, #{status}, 1, #{price}, #{expires_at}, #{paid_at}, #{cancelled_at} FROM next_order RETURNING orderno
mapper.update: update "interviewworks_ticket"."session" "session" set capacity = capacity + 1, reserved = reserved - 1 where "session".id = #{session_id} and "session".capacity - "session".reserved - "session".sold >= 1
update "interviewworks_ticket"."session" "session" set reserved = reserved - 1, sold = sold + 1 where "session".id = #{session_id} and "session".capacity - "session".reserved - "session".sold >= 1
